digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler — typed payloads and shadow-replay oracle
propositions: Build versioned direction/action typed payload union types validated at construction time, rejecting missing/extra/wrong fields before effects reach production entry points.

Implement side-effect-free shadow trace projection for both legacy and typed planning/serialization over identical deterministic synthetic and scrubbed corpus observations, comparing order/fields/identity/diagnostics/retry without invoking Jira/store writers.

Corpus covers all shape classes (create/update/delete/probe/conflict), inbound-only actions, field mutations, duplicates, malformed inputs, suppression/follow-ons, ambiguous outcomes, retry exhaustion, and multi-project routing with explicit provenance and normalization rules.

Production dispatch entry points and writers remain byte-identical and unmodified; new shadow-only modules are exercised only by tests and never imported by production paths, proven by route-census check.

Four approved intentional deltas between legacy and typed contracts (inbound-conflict payload reason placement, outbound delete/probe rejects stray fields, outbound update requires nonempty payload, inbound delete/probe out of scope) are named, ratified, and asserted in corpus tests.
Effect spies on all Jira/store/subprocess/clock/network seams fail if shadow path violates determinism contract, and corpus replay is idempotent with explicit version and versioning rules documented.
